name: Valentin Borisovich Aleskovskii
summary: Soviet chemist, professor, and founder of the molecular layering method.

name: Stanislav Ivanovich Kol'tsov
summary: Chemist and graduate student of Aleskovskii who co-developed the molecular layering method.

name: Leningrad Technological Institute by Lensovet
summary: Educational and research institute in Leningrad where Aleskovskii worked for most of his career.

name: Naval Research Institute
summary: Research institute in Leningrad where Aleskovskii worked as a research fellow.

name: Leningrad State University
summary: University where Aleskovskii served as rector and organized the Department of Solid State Chemistry.

name: Academy of Sciences of the USSR
summary: National academy where Aleskovskii was elected a corresponding member.

name: Mary
summary: City in Turkmenistan where Aleskovskii was born.

name: Framework Hypothesis
summary: Scientific hypothesis proposed by Aleskovskii regarding the structure of solids.

name: Molecular Layering Method
summary: Technique for gas-phase layer by layer deposition developed by Aleskovskii and Kol'tsov.
